title: Best Network Switch (2026)
summary: We're still testing and researching this guide. Picks will be added soon.
method: Picks were made by reviewing the product lists and detailed reviews from pc‑mag.com, networkswitchreviews.com, networkgearreview.com, and wired.com. Products appearing in more than one source were prioritized.
assumptions: Prices are not included because none of the sources provide them.

verdict.line: Picture a small business with 48 devices that need reliable, PoE‑enabled connections. The NETGEAR 48‑Port PoE+ Gigabit Ethernet Switch delivers that with a large port count and PoE+ support, making it ideal for growing offices or data‑center setups. Its main catch is that it is unmanaged, so advanced configuration is not possible.
also: TP‑Link TL‑SG108PE 8‑Port Smart Managed Gigabit PoE Switch
